exposure: Integration of visual analytic tools into an EHR system (EPIC)
outcome: Identification of 5 visual themes for successful visualizations
Improved efficiency in developing visualizations for future projects
Improved obstetric operating room efficiency (as an exemplary project aim)
cohort: The study focused on 12 clinician-initiated quality improvement projects where visual analytic tools were created and integrated into an EHR system.
finding: The study identified 5 common visual themes (scheduling & optimization, provider assessment, executive assessment, patient outcomes, and control/goal charts) that were integral to the success of 12 quality improvement projects involving EHR-integrated visualizations.
